Clara M: Quick QBR ask: can we produce a one-page cost appendix for three onboarding accounts (NovaGrid, TerraWave, Solara)? Need runway, top spend driver, and one tactical mitigation each. 1 slide per account.
Devon R: I can take NovaGrid. What window?
Clara M: Use 30d trend + 7d spike. Add a tiny "days until credits" calc at current burn.
Isha V: TerraWave for me. I'll focus on embed rebuilds and any bulk-import jobs.
Grant P: Solara assigned. I'll run a compact QPS x seq sensitivity and estimate quantization ROI.
Clara M: New renewal-risk rule: flag if (MoM variance > 20% AND projected runout < 25 days). If flagged, suggest immediate outreach + one-time $4k pilot credit (pre-approved).
Devon R: Running a quick sim tool for NovaGrid:
```
./tools/quick_sim --acct NOVAGRID --horizon 30 --qps 25,50,100 --lens 128,512,1024 --out novagrid.csv
```
Isha V: TerraWave has nightly full-embed rebuilds; looks like ~50% of 7d spend. Recommend switching to incremental + shard window.
Grant P: Uploaded sensitivity CSVs to Drive: https://drive.redwood/qbr/solara-sim.csv. Headline: 100qps@1024 -> ~$1.7k/day unoptimized, quantize est ~33% savings.
Clara M: Owners recap: NovaGrid=Devon, TerraWave=Isha, Solara=Grant. Deliverables due Wed 6pm PT so I can fold into Thu QBR. Dry-run Thu 9am PT.
Devon R: @DataOps can you grant read to devon.r@redwood on novagrid-prod-billing?
DataOps Bot: access granted to devon.r@redwood for project novagrid-prod-billing.
Isha V: I'll draft the one-paragraph enablement blurb: short, prescriptive with three quick wins and how to accept the pilot.
Clara M: Perfect. If any blockers with data or sims, flag here immediately. I'll assemble Wed evening and send a preview Thu morning. :white_check_mark:
